rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam is a foreign name, probably on the pattern fāʿil; it may derive from earth's surface or complexion, as names of Jacob, Idris and Iblis have proposed derivations.
rows.anchor: هو اسم أعجمي وأقرب أمره أن يكون على فاعل كآزر واشتقاقهم آدم من أديم الأرض أو من الأدمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means the names of the named things: the genitive complement is omitted because it is understood from the word names.
rows.anchor: فحذف المضاف إليه لكونه معلوما مدلولا عليه بذكر الأسماء إذ الاسم يدل على المسمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The definite article compensates for the omitted complement, as in the Qur'anic phrase about the head flaring gray.
rows.anchor: وعوض منه اللام كقوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is incorrect to construe the verse as teaching the objects rather than their names, since the command explicitly asks for their names.
rows.anchor: ولا يصح أن يقدر وعلم آدم مسميات الأسماء على حذف المضاف وإقامة المضاف إليه مقامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God showed Adam the created kinds and taught him each object's name, such as horse and camel.
rows.anchor: أنه تعالى أراه الأجناس التى خلقها وعلمه أن هذا اسمه فرس وهذا اسمه بعير

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that Adam was taught the name of every thing, even a bowl and small items.
rows.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما علمه اسم كل شيء حتى القصعة والمعرفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine plural pronoun refers to the displayed things because rational beings are included among them and take grammatical precedence.
rows.anchor: إنما ذكر لأن فى المسميات العقلاء فغلبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God questioned the angels to expose and rebuke them, despite already knowing they could not name the things.
rows.anchor: استنبأهم وقد علم عجزهم عن الإنباء على سبيل التبكيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge answers the angels' claim that a human successor would spread corruption and bloodshed by showing the knowledge-based benefits of that appointment.
rows.anchor: فى زعمكم أنى أستخلف فى الأرض مفسدين سفاكين للدماء وفيه رد عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel is Jacob's title; in their language it means either God's chosen one or God's servant, with Israel formed from a word for servant/chosen and El for God.
rows.anchor: هو يعقوب عليه السلام وهو لقب له ومعناه فى لسانهم صفوة الله أو عبد الله فإسرا هو العبد أو الصفوة وإيل هو الله بالعبرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel is indeclinable because it combines proper-name status with foreign origin.
rows.anchor: وهو غير منصرف لوجود العليمة والعجمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recalling blessings should lead them to thank God and obey the giver; the blessings include their ancestors' rescue from Pharaoh and drowning, pardon for the calf, and acceptance of repentance.
rows.anchor: ذكرهم النعمة أن لا يخلوا بشكرها ويطيعوا مانحها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further blessing was that they lived to see Muhammad, whose coming was announced in the Torah and Gospel.
rows.anchor: وما أنعم به عليهم من إدراك زمن محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم المبشر به فى التوراة والإنجيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chosen form of the verb means to discharge a covenant completely; although both forms are used, this one is the preferred usage and Qur'anic form.
rows.anchor: والاختيار أوفيت وعليه نزل التنزيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The covenant to be fulfilled means either faith in God and obedience to Him or faith in the Prophet of mercy and the miraculous Book.
rows.anchor: من الإيمان بى والطاعة لى أو من الإيمان بنبى الرحمة والكتاب المعجز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's covenant in return is the good reward promised for good deeds.
rows.anchor: بما عاهدتكم عليه من حسن الثواب على حسناتكم والعهد يضاف إلى المعاهد

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatadah interprets the covenant as a promise: if you uphold it, God will forgive you.
rows.anchor: وعن قتادة هما لئن أقمتم ولأكفرن

rows.speaker: أهل الإشارة
rows.claim: The people of allusion read the covenant mystically: serve reverently in the abode of trial and receive the joy of divine vision in the abode of grace.
rows.anchor: وقال أهل الإشارة أوفوا فى دار محنتى على بساط خدمتى بحفظ حرمتى أوف فى دار نعمتى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear God alone and do not break the covenant; fronting the object gives stronger restriction than the wording of You alone we worship.
rows.anchor: فلا تنقضوا عهدى وهو من قولك زيدا رهبته وهو أوكد فى إفادة الاختصاص من إياك نعبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An implied first verb governs the fronted object; it is omitted because the following verb indicates it, and that following verb already takes its object pronoun.
rows.anchor: وإياي منصوب بفعل مضمر دل عليه ما بعده وتقديره فارهبوا إياي فارهبون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seek God's help for your needs by combining patience with prayer and patiently bearing prayer's duties, sincerity, distractions, etiquette and humility while knowing one stands before the Lord of heaven and earth.
rows.anchor: تصلوا صابرين على تكاليف الصلاة محتملين لمشاقها وما يجب فيها من إخلاص القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another application is to endure calamities and turn to prayer when they occur; the Prophet used to resort to prayer when distressed.
rows.anchor: بالصبر عليها والالتجاء إلى الصلاة عند وقوعها وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا حزبه أمر فزع إلى الصلاة

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: When his brother Qutham died while Ibn Abbas was travelling, he said the words of return to God, prayed two rakahs, and invoked this command.
rows.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما أنه نعى إليه أخوه وقثم وهو فى سفر فاسترجع وصلى ركعتين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation takes patience to mean fasting, since fasting restrains one from things that break the fast and Ramadan is called the month of patience.
rows.anchor: وقيل الصبر الصوم لأنه حبس عن المفطرات ومنه قيل لشهر رمضان شهر الصبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes prayer to mean supplication: endure affliction and implore God to remove it.
rows.anchor: وقيل الصلاة الدعاء أي استعينوا على البلايا بالصبر والإلتجاء إلى الدعاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The feminine pronoun in the next clause may refer either to prayer or to seeking help.
rows.anchor: الضمير للصلاة أو للاستعانة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer or seeking help is burdensome in the sense of difficult and heavy, but not for the humble.
rows.anchor: لشاقة ثقيلة من قولك كبر على هذا الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humble find it easier because they expect the reward stored up for those who bear its hardships.
rows.anchor: لأنهم يتوقعون ما ادخر للصابرين على متاعبها فتهون عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one food was manna and quail; it was called one because it did not change, as a person may call a daily unchanging menu one food despite its variety.
rows.anchor: هو ما رزقوا في التيه من المن والسلوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they considered manna and quail one kind because both were refined foods, while they wanted the vegetables and grains familiar to an agricultural people.
rows.anchor: أو أرادوا أنهما ضرب واحد لأنهما معا من طعام أهل التلذد والتترف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask Moses to ask God to bring forth food; the verbs mean to ask and to manifest or produce.
rows.anchor: وقل له أخرج لنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested greens are the earth's vegetables, especially choice herbs such as mint, celery and leek.
rows.anchor: هو ما أنبتته الأرض من الخضر والمراد به أطايب البقول كالنعناع والكرفس والكراث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qiththa means cucumber.
rows.anchor: يعنى الخيار ﴿ وفومها ﴾ هو الحنطة

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Fum means either wheat or garlic; Ibn Masud's reading has thum, garlic.
rows.anchor: لقراءة ابن مسعود وثومها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adna means lower in rank and lesser in value, while what is better is higher and nobler.
rows.anchor: أقرب منزلة وأدون مقدارا والدنو والقرب يعبر بهما عن قلة المقدار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Misr may mean any city, to which they descend from the wilderness, located between Jerusalem and Qinnasrin; the wilderness is twelve by eight farsakhs.
rows.anchor: من الأمصار أى انحدروا إليه من التيه وبلاد التيه ما بين بيت المقدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Misr means Pharaoh's Egypt; it is declined despite feminine and proper-name features because it means a town or has a quiescent middle consonant, like Noah and Lot.
rows.anchor: صرفه مع وجود السببين وهما التأنيث والتعريف لارادة البلد أو لسكون وسطه كنوح ولوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The things they requested are available in cities, not in the wilderness.
rows.anchor: فإن الذى سألتم يكون فى الأمصار لا فى التيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humiliation and poverty surround and cling to them; Jews are subdued and poor either literally or by displaying poverty out of fear of an increased poll tax.
rows.anchor: أى الهوان والفقر يعنى جعلت الذلة محيطة بهم مشتملة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They may be poor in fact or display poverty and humility from fear that the jizya will be doubled.
rows.anchor: إما على الحقيقة و إما لتصاغرهم وتفاقرهم خيفة أن تضاعف عليهم الجزية

rows.speaker: حمزة وعلى
rows.claim: Hamzah and al-Kisa'i have a distinct vocalization of the pronoun in عليهم; Abu Amr kasras both hā and mīm, while the other readers kasra the hā and damma the mīm.
rows.anchor: عليهم الذلة حمزة وعلى وكذا كل ما كان قبل الهاء ياء ساكنة وبكسر الهاء والميم أبو عمرو

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو
rows.claim: Abu Amr reads the pronoun with kasra on both hā and mīm; the remaining readers kasra hā and damma mīm.
rows.anchor: وبكسر الهاء والميم أبو عمرو وبكسر الهاء وضم الميم غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To incur God's anger means to become deserving of it, by analogy with one who is liable to be killed in return for an equal victim.
rows.anchor: من قولك باء فلان بفلان إذا كان حقيقيا بأن يقتل به لمساواته له أى صاروا أحقاء بغضبه

rows.speaker: الكسائي
rows.claim: Al-Kisa'i is reported to read the following word as حفوا.
rows.anchor: وعن الكسائي حفوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first that refers to the imposed humiliation, poverty and deserved anger.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى ما تقدم من ضرب الذلة والمسكنة والخلاقة بالغضب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their unbelief and killing of prophets caused their punishment; the prophets killed by the Jews included Isaiah, Zechariah and John.
rows.anchor: وقد قتلت اليهود شعياء وزكريا ويحيا صلوات الله عليهم

rows.speaker: نافع
rows.claim: Nafi' pronounces the word for prophets with a hamza, as in its related forms.
rows.anchor: بالهمزة نافع وكذا بابه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nabī may derive from informing, as one who tells from God, or from rising; nubuwwa is an elevated place.
rows.anchor: والنبي من النبأ لأنه يخبر عن الله تعالى فعيل بمعنى مفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Killing them without right means even by their own standard; the Torah did not warrant their killing, and the phrase is a circumstantial accusative describing wrongful killing.
rows.anchor: عندهم أيضا فإنهم لو أنصفوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated that may refer to sins generally, or specifically to Sabbath transgression; alternatively unbelief and killing arose from persistent disobedience and excess that hardened their hearts.
rows.anchor: وقيل هو اعتداؤهم في السبت ويجوز أن يشار بذلك إلى الكفر وقتل الأنبياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The final that may point to unbelief and killing prophets together with the other acts of disobedience.
rows.anchor: أو ذلك الكفر والقتل مع ما عصوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fools are identified as Jews angry at facing the Kaaba and unwilling to accept abrogation.
rows.anchor: هم اليهود لكراهتمهم التوجه إلى الكعبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively they are hypocrites, eager to attack and ridicule.
rows.anchor: أو المنافقون لحرصهم على الطعن والاستهزاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively they are polytheists who mocked Muhammad for leaving his ancestral qibla and returning, predicting he would return to their religion.
rows.anchor: المشركون لقولهم رغب عن قبلة آبائه ثم رجع اليها والله ليرجعن إلى دينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Announcing their objection before it occurs prepares the audience, since advance warning makes an unpleasant event less jarring and a prepared answer more effectively silences an opponent.
rows.anchor: وفائدة الإخبار بقولهم قبل وقوعه توطين النفس إذ المفاجأة بالمكروه أشد وعداد الجواب قبل الحاجة إليه أقطع للخصم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The former qibla was Jerusalem; qibla means the direction a person faces in prayer.
rows.anchor: يعنون بيت المقدس والقبلة الجهة التى يستقبلها الإنسان فى الصلاة لأن المصلى يقابلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The east and west mean their lands, and the whole earth belongs to God.
rows.anchor: بلاد الشرق والمغرب و الأرض كلها له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path may mean guidance to the true qibla, the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: يرشد من يشاء إلى قبلة الحق وهى الكعبة التى أمرنا بالتوجه إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, all places belong to God, who may command facing Jerusalem at one time and the Kaaba at another, without objection.
rows.anchor: الأماكن كلها لله فيأمر بالتوجه إلى حيث شاء فتارة الكعبة وطورا إلى البيت المقدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Likewise means a comparable act of making; the kaf marks similarity, the demonstrative distinguishes near from distant reference, and the attached kaf is vocative and uninflected.
rows.anchor: ومثل ذلك الجعل جعلناكم فالكاف للتشبيه وذاجر بالكاف واللام للفرق بين الإشارة إلى القريب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wasat means the best: the middle is protected from defects that quickly reach the edges, so the community is best as its qibla is the best qibla.
rows.anchor: خيارا وقيل للخيار وسط لأن الأطراف يتسارع إليها الخلل والأوساط محمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, wasat means just and balanced; the community is moderate between Christian excess in deifying Jesus and Jewish disparagement of Mary and Jesus.
rows.anchor: أو عدولا لأن الوسط عدل بين الأطراف ليس إلى بعضها أقرب من بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Witnesses is diptote because of the feminine alif, and the phrase on people complements witnesses.
rows.anchor: غير منصرف لمكان ألف التأنيث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At Judgment, nations deny that prophets delivered the message; Muhammad's community testifies from God's revealed Book, and Muhammad then testifies to their justice. Testimony can rely on widely known reports, and witness is followed by 'over' because a witness is like a watcher.
rows.anchor: أن الأمم يوم القيامة يجحدون تبليغ الأنبياء فيطالب الله الأنبياء البينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the community testifies in this world in cases requiring upright witnesses, while the Messenger endorses and certifies their justness.
rows.anchor: فى الدنيا فيما لا يصح إلا بشهادة العدول الأخيار ويكون الرسول عليكم شهيدا

rows.speaker: أبو منصور
rows.claim: Abu Mansur adduces the verse for the authority of consensus.
rows.anchor: واستدل الشيخ أبو منصور رحمه الله بالآية على أن الإجماع حجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Mansur's argument is that God calls the community just, and just people are qualified to testify; when they agree on something and testify to it, acceptance is required.
rows.anchor: لأن الله تعالى وصف هذه الأمة بالعدالة والعدل هو المستحق للشهادة وقبولها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The order of the complements changes because the first clause establishes the community's testimony over nations, while the second singles out the Messenger as their witness.
rows.anchor: واخرت صلة الشهادة أو لا وقدمت آخرا لأن المراد فى الأول إثبات شهادتهم على الأمم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The qibla was the direction faced, the Kaaba: in Mecca Muhammad prayed toward it, after migration he was directed to Jerusalem's rock to conciliate Jews, then he was turned back to the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: روى أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلى بمكة إلى الكعبة ثم أمر بالصلاة إلى صخرة بيت المقدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The change was a trial distinguishing firm, sincere Muslims from wavering people who turned back and apostatized when the qibla changed.
rows.anchor: لنعلم الثابث على الإسلام الصادق فيه ممن هو على حرف ينكص على عقبيه

rows.speaker: أبو منصور
rows.claim: Abu Mansur explains 'that We may know' as God knowing, once it exists, what He eternally knew would come to exist; change is in the known thing, not in God's knowledge.
rows.anchor: قال الشيخ أبو منصور رحمه الله معنى قوله لنعلم أى لنعلم كائنا أو موجودا ما قد علمناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, knowledge is put for distinguishing those who turn back from the steadfast, as in the verse about God distinguishing the bad from the good.
rows.anchor: النابع من الناكص كما قال تعالى ليميز الله الخبيث من الطيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the knowledge meant is that of the Messenger and believers, attributed to God because they are His chosen intimates.
rows.anchor: أو ليعلم رسول الله عليه الصلاة والسلام والمؤمنون وإنما أسند علمهم إلى ذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, this is a gracious way to address someone who does not know, like telling a denier of gold's melting to put it in fire to see whether it melts.
rows.anchor: أو هو على ملاطفة الخطاب لمن لا يعلم كقولك لمن ينكر ذوب الذهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The feminine pronoun may refer to the change, act of making, or qibla; in the lightened conditional particle, the lam distinguishes it and kabira is the predicate.
rows.anchor: أى التحويلة أو الجعلة أو القبلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception refers to those God guided, with the omitted antecedent being those steadfast and sincere in following the Messenger.
rows.anchor: أى هداهم الله فحذف العائد أى إلا على الثابتين الصادقين فى اتباع الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith here means prayers toward Jerusalem: they are called faith because prayer is prescribed for, accepted from and performed as evidence by believers; the verse answered concern about those who died before the change.
rows.anchor: أى صلاتكم إلى بيت المقدس سمى الصلاة ايمانا لأن وجوبها على أهل الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ra'uf is read with an extended hamza by the Hijazis, Syrians and Hafs, and without it by others; both are intensive forms, and ra'fa is stronger than mercy, hence the pairing.
rows.anchor: مهموز مشبع حجازى وشامى وحفص رءوف غيرهم بوزن فعل وهما المبالغة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Through patience one attains every virtue.
rows.anchor: فيه تنال كل فضيلة ﴿ والصلاة ﴾ فإنها تنهى عن كل رذيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer restrains every vice, and God's being with the patient means victory and assistance.
rows.anchor: ﴿ إن الله مع الصابرين ﴾ بالنصر والمعونة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone is divine, without partner, and no other can rightly be called a god.
rows.anchor: فرد فى ألوهيته لا شريك له فيها ولا يصح أن يسمى غيره إلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause there is no god but Him confirms oneness by denying every other and affirming Him; huwa is nominative as a substitute for the position of la ilaha, since the verse stresses the second clause rather than the first.
rows.anchor: تقرير للوحدانية بنفى غيره وإثباته وموضع هو رفع لأنه بدل من موضع لا اله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Huwa cannot be accusative here, because that would place emphasis on the first clause, whereas the meaning depends on stressing the second.
rows.anchor: ولا يجوز النصب هنا لأن البدل يدل على أن الاعتماد على الثاني والمعنى فى الآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raised names al-Rahman and al-Rahim describe the possessor of every original and derivative blessing; nothing else has this quality, since everything else is a blessing or its recipient.
rows.anchor: أى المولى لجميع النعم أصولها وفروعها ولا شيء سواه بهذه الصفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their nominative case can be a predicate of an omitted subject or an appositive to huwa, not an adjective because a pronoun is not qualified.
rows.anchor: رفع على أنه خبر مبتدأ أو على البدل من هولا على الوصف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Complete Hajj and umrah by observing their conditions and obligations for God's sake, without slackness or deficiency.
rows.anchor: وأدوهما تأمين بشرائطهما وفرائضمها لوجه الله تعالى بلا توان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view says completion means continuing after starting; it implies that beginning either rite makes its completion obligatory, including umrah.
rows.anchor: وقيل الإتمام يكون بعد الشروع فهو دليل على أن من شرع فيهما لزمه اتمامهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse does not prove that umrah is initially obligatory, as al-Shafi'i argues, because completing either an obligatory or voluntary rite may be commanded.
rows.anchor: ولا تمسك للشافعى رحمه الله بالآية على لزوم العمرة لأنه أمر بإتمامها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other interpretations of completing the rites are to enter ihram from one's home, make a separate journey for each, spend lawful wealth on both, or refrain from trading during them.
rows.anchor: أو إتمامهما أن تحرم بهما من دويرة أهلك أو أن تفرد لكل واحد منهما سفرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ahsara means being prevented by fear, illness or incapacity, whereas hasara is confinement by an enemy; the Hanafi view recognizes any impediment as ihsar.
rows.anchor: يقال أحصر فلان إذا منعه أمر من خوف أو مرض أو عجز وحصر إذا حبسه عدو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says one who breaks a bone or becomes lame may exit ihram and owes Hajj the following year.
rows.anchor: وقد جاء فى الحديث من كسر أو عرج فقد حل أى جاز له أن يحل وعليه الحج من قابل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Shafi'i restricts ihsar to obstruction by an enemy, but the verse's wording includes any impediment.
rows.anchor: وعند الشافعى رحمه الله الإحصار بالعدو وحده وظاهر النص يدل على أن الإحصار يتحقق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mention of both rites shows that ihsar can occur in umrah as well as Hajj.
rows.anchor: وظاهر النص يدل على أن الإحصار يتحقق فى العمرة أيضا لأنه ذكر عقبهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means whatever sacrificial animal is accessible; one blocked from the House in ihram for either rite may offer an obtainable camel, cow or sheep.
rows.anchor: فما تيسر منه يقال يسر الأمر واستيسر كما يقال صعب واستصعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The noun ما may be nominative as the subject with an implied عليكم or accusative with an implied verb meaning offer.
rows.anchor: فما رفع بالابتداء أى فعليكم ما استيسر أو نصب أى فاهدوا له ما استيسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command addresses those prevented from pilgrimage: they must not exit by shaving until they know their offering has reached its required slaughter place in the Haram; this supports the Hanafi position against al-Shafi'i that ihsar offerings are slaughtered only there.
rows.anchor: الخطاب للمحصرين أى لا تحلوا بحلق الرأس حتى تعلموا أن الهدى الذى بعثتموه إلى الحرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If sickness requires shaving or a head ailment such as lice or a wound causes it, the pilgrim owes ransom: three days' fasting, feeding six poor people half a sa' of wheat each, or a sheep sacrifice.
rows.anchor: فعليه إذا حلق فدية ﴿ من صيام ﴾ ثلاثة أيام ﴿ أو صدقة ﴾ على ستة مساكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being secure means not prevented; enjoying umrah until Hajj means benefit from its devotion before Hajj, or, alternatively, enjoying formerly forbidden things after leaving umrah until Hajj ihram.
rows.anchor: الاحصار أى فإذا لم تحصروا وكنتم فى حال أمن وسعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative explains enjoyment as permission to use things forbidden in ihram after finishing umrah until Hajj ihram begins.
rows.anchor: وقيل إذا حل من عمرته انتفع باستباحة ما كان محرما عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tamattu offering is a ritual sacrifice that may be eaten and is slaughtered on the day of sacrifice.
rows.anchor: هو هدى المتعة وهو نسك يؤكل منه ويذبح يوم النحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One unable to find an offering fasts three days during the Hajj season, whose months run between umrah and Hajj ihram, then seven days after departing and completing the rites.
rows.anchor: فعليه صيام ثلاثة أيام فى وقت الحج وهو أشهره ما بين الإحرامين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ten days fully substitute for the offering, may have complete reward, or clarify that the conjunction does not make the number optional.
rows.anchor: في وقوعها بدلا عن الهدى أو فى الثواب أو المراد رفع الإبهام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the Hanafi school, the indicated rule of tamattu applies to those whose families are not residents of the Haram; residents cannot perform tamattu or qiran.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى التمتع عندنا إذلا تمتع ولا قران لحاضرى المسجد الحرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Shafi'i takes that to refer to the obligation of sacrifice or fasting, but imposes no such obligation on residents of the Haram.
rows.anchor: وعند الشافعى رحمه الله إلى الحكم الذى هو وجوب الهدى أو الصيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Residents of the Haram are those living at the miqats and inward from them toward Mecca.
rows.anchor: هم أهل المواقيت فمن دونها إلى مكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear God in pilgrimage and all else He commands or forbids; He severely punishes those who do not fear Him.
rows.anchor: فيما أمركم به ونهاكم عنه فى الحج وغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Literally laghw is discarded, uncounted speech; an idle oath is swearing about something believed true that proves false, and carries no punishment.
rows.anchor: اللغو الساقط الذى لا يعتد به من كلام وغيره ولغو اليمين الساقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Shafi'i instead defines an idle oath as an unintentional phrase that slips from the tongue, such as no, by God or yes, by God.
rows.anchor: الشافعى رحمه الله هو ما يجرى على لسانه من غير قصد للحلف نحو لا والله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The culpable earning of the heart is intentionally lying in an oath one knows to be false, the solemn ghamus oath.
rows.anchor: بما اقترفته من إثم القصد إلى الكذب فى اليمين وهو أن يحلف على ما يعلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Shafi'i uses the verse to support expiation for a ghamus oath: earning of the heart is intention, and the expiation stated in al-Ma'ida explains this verse.
rows.anchor: وتعلق الشافعى بهذا النص على وجوب الكفارة فى الغموس لأن كسب القلب العزم والقصد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author rejects that inference: accountability here is unqualified and belongs to the afterlife, while al-Ma'ida specifies accountability in worldly testing, so the two should not be equated.
rows.anchor: وقلنا المؤاخذة هنا مطللقة وهى فى دار الجزاء والمؤاخذة ثم مقيدة بدار الابتلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is forgiving and forbearing in not holding people accountable for idle oaths.
rows.anchor: حيث لم يؤاخذكم باللغو فى أيمانكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a debtor is insolvent, the ruling or command is to grant time until solvency; maysara has two language forms, one read by Nafi'.
rows.anchor: وقع غريم من غرمائكم ذو عسرة ذو إعسار

rows.speaker: عاصم
rows.claim: Asim reads the verb with lightening, meaning creditors remit all or part of the principal for an insolvent debtor; other readers use the assimilated, doubled form.
rows.anchor: بالتخفيف عاصم أى تتصدقوا برؤس أموالكم أو ببعضها على من أعسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The light reading omits one of the two tāʾs; the heavier reading assimilates them.
rows.anchor: فالتخفيف على حذف إحدى التاءين والتشديد على الإدغام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes charity to mean granting the insolvent debtor more time; a Prophetic report says delaying an owed debt earns charity for every day.
rows.anchor: وقيل أريد بالتصدق الإنظار لقوله عليه السلام لا يحل دين رجل مسلم فيؤخره إلا كان له بكل يوم صدقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people know this is better for them and fail to act, they are treated as if they do not know.
rows.anchor: جعل من لا يعمل به و إن علمه كأنه لا يعلمه

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو
rows.claim: Abu Amr reads ترجعون with an intransitive sense, while the other form can be transitive.
rows.anchor: ترجعون أبو عمرو فرجع لازم ومتعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unnamed report says this was the last verse brought down by Gabriel, who instructed that it be placed at the head of verse 280 of al-Baqara; the Prophet lived afterward for 21, 81 or 7 days, or three hours.
rows.anchor: قيل هي آخر آية نزل بها جبريل عليه السلام وقال ضعها فى رأس المائتين والثمانين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every soul is given the recompense of what it earned, without injustice through reducing good deeds or increasing bad ones.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وهم لا يظلمون ﴾ بنقصان الحسنات وزيادة السيآت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forms people in wombs in whatever differing forms He wills.
rows.anchor: ﴿ هو الذي يصوركم في الأرحام كيف يشاء ﴾ من الصور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is mighty in His authority and wise in His governance.
rows.anchor: ﴿ لا إله إلا هو العزيز ﴾ فى سلطانه ﴿ الحكيم ﴾ فى تدبيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report recounts the visit of the sixty-member Najran delegation, led by al-Aqib, al-Sayyid and their bishop-scholar Abu Haritha, who disputed whether Jesus was God's son and, if not, who his father was.
rows.anchor: روى أنه لما قدم وفد بنى نجران وهم ستون راكبا أميرهم العاقب وعمدتهم السيد وأسقفهم وحبرهم أبو حارثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad argued that a child resembles its father, God is living and never dies while Jesus dies, and God sustains servants whereas Jesus cannot preserve or provide for them.
rows.anchor: ألستم تعلمون أنه لا يكون ولد إلا وهو يشبه أباه قالوا بلى قال ألم تعلموا أن الله تعالى حى لا يموت وعيسى يموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The report contrasts God's complete knowledge of heaven and earth with Jesus' knowledge only of what was taught to him; Jesus was formed in a womb, born, nursed, ate and defecated, unlike God.
rows.anchor: لا يخفى عليه شيء فى الأرض ولا فى السماء وعيسى لا يعلم إلا ما علم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The delegation was silenced, and the opening eighty-odd verses of al-Imran were revealed concerning them.
rows.anchor: فانقطعوا فنزل فيهم صدر سورة آل عمران إلى بضع وثمانين آية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Allahumma the mīm replaces yā and the two do not combine; this name has other special features in oath, vocative use, hamza and emphatic pronunciation.
rows.anchor: الميم عوض من يا ولذا لا يجتمعان وهذا بعض خصائص هذا الاسم كما اختص بالتاء فى القسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah owns the entire class of dominion and disposes of it as owners dispose of their property; this phrase is a second vocative.
rows.anchor: تملك جنس الملك فتتصرف فيه تصرف الملاك فيما يملكون وهو نداء ثان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Granting and removing kingship refer to particular shares carved out of the general dominion mentioned first.
rows.anchor: فالملك الاول عام والملكان الآخران خاصان مضان من الكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says that after the conquest of Mecca the Prophet promised his community Persia's and Rome's kingdoms; Jews and hypocrites dismissed the prospect because those powers were stronger and more secure.
rows.anchor: روى أنه عليه السلام حين فتح مكة واعدأمته ملك فارس والروم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God honors through granting kingship and humiliates by taking it away.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وتعز من تشاء ﴾ بالملك ﴿ وتذل من تشاء ﴾ بنزعه منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning good can stand for both sides of a pair; alternatively, the context specifically means the good and honor granted to believers despite what disbelievers denied.
rows.anchor: أى الخير والشرفا كفتى بذكر أحد الضدين عن الآخر أو لأن الكلام وقع فى الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God can do everything; no one else can do anything except through His enabling.
rows.anchor: ولا يقدر على شيء أحد غيرك إلا بإقدارك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other interpretations take kingship as health or contentment, or as night prayer; a Prophetic saying calls those of the community content with a day's provision kings of Paradise.
rows.anchor: وقيل المراد بالملك ملك العافية أو ملك القناعة قال عليه السلام ملوك الجنة من أمتى

rows.speaker: الشبلي
rows.claim: Al-Shibli interprets kingship as dispensing with both worlds through being content with the Creator; spiritual honor comes through knowledge, such contentment or sufficiency, and humiliation through their opposites.
rows.anchor: وعن الشبلى الاستغناء بالمكون عن الكونين تعز بالمعرفة أو بالاستغناء بالمكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book may mean holders of the two scriptures, the Najran delegation, or the Jews of Medina.
rows.anchor: هم أهل الكتابين أو وفد نجران أو يهود المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shared, even-handed word is one on which Quran, Torah and Gospel do not differ.
rows.anchor: لا يختلف فيها القرآن والتوراة والإنجيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word is to worship God alone, associate nothing with Him, and not make humans lords besides Him; this rejects claims that Ezra or Christ is God's son and the uncritical adoption of scholars' innovations about lawful and forbidden things.
rows.anchor: يعنى تعالوا إليها حتى لا تقول عزير ابن الله ولا المسيح ابن الله

rows.speaker: عدي بن حاتم
rows.claim: Adi ibn Hatim said they had not worshipped their scholars; Muhammad replied that following their rulings making things lawful and forbidden was worship, and Adi agreed.
rows.anchor: وعن عدى بن حاتم ما كنا نعبدهم يا رسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they turn away from monotheism, tell them the proof is established and they must acknowledge that the Muslims are rightly Muslim, like a victor demanding the defeated admit defeat.
rows.anchor: أى لزمتكم الحجة فوجب عليكم أن تعترفوا وتسلموا بأنا مسلمون دونكم
